neighbours.label: the noun right after 'on'/'على' in a fixed spatial or causal idiom: 'on account (of)', 'on top (of)', Arabic 'على بعد' (at a distance of)
fire: The match was postponed on account of the heavy rain that fell all afternoon.
She set the vase on top of the old wooden cabinet near the window.
يقع الفندق على بعد خمس دقائق من محطة القطار الرئيسية.
He was excused from the school trip on account of his poor health.
Spread the cream evenly on top of the cooled cake before serving it.
تقع القرية الصغيرة على بعد عشرين كيلومترا من المدينة.
Dozens of flights were cancelled on account of the air traffic strike.
Put a heavy dictionary on top of the pressed flowers overnight.
quiet: The match was postponed because of the heavy rain that fell all afternoon.
She opened a savings account at the bank across from her office.
يقع الفندق قرب محطة القطار الرئيسية في وسط البلد.
He gave his parents a detailed account of the school trip.
The top of the old wooden cabinet was covered in a thick layer of dust.
تقع القرية الصغيرة بالقرب من المدينة الكبيرة.
Dozens of flights were cancelled due to the air traffic strike.
Spread the cream evenly over the cooled cake before serving it.

notes: the - pole is the month after 'on' in dates (on April 1); + looks like the non-date idiomatic continuation of 'on'
